dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...I couldn't find anyone. I only found a broken pick. I can only hope that you will not mourn too much, Elder Sister..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...We and Uncle Daiki have raised enough money between us to arrange this matter. But since you insist on refusing, please take the money for your living expenses instead..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...Chouji is still a kid. Elder Sister, you've taken up the job in the mine, so please rest more and don't turn our gift down..."
